information_requirements.information_requirement: Live inventory availability and stock levels
information_requirements.description: Real-time data indicating the exact quantity of each SKU available at a specific store location at the precise moment of order allocation.
information_requirements.business_purpose: To prevent overselling and ensure that the Order Allocation Engine can only assign orders to stores where items are physically present.
information_requirements.information_usage: Used as a hard constraint to validate eligibility before generating a fulfillment task.
information_requirements.information_source: Direct API integration with Store Partner Point of Sale (POS) systems or inventory management software.

information_requirements.information_requirement: Dynamic real-time traffic and road conditions
information_requirements.description: Current environmental data regarding traffic density, weather hazards, and road closures within the defined service areas.
information_requirements.business_purpose: To enable the Order Allocation Engine and Delivery Partners to dynamically adjust delivery time estimates and route selection to meet the <60 minute SLA.
information_requirements.information_usage: Used to recalculate estimated time of arrival (ETA) and adjust assigned delivery windows or reassign agents if delays are imminent.
information_requirements.information_source: External Third-Party Traffic APIs (e.g., Google Maps, TomTom) and local weather feeds.

information_requirements.description: Detailed physical state of items including freshness, packaging integrity, and signs of damage or spoilage at the time of handover.
information_requirements.business_purpose: To provide the data foundation for accurate customer verification, automated dispute resolution, and liability determination regarding product quality.
information_requirements.information_usage: Serves as the primary evidence for validating 'as-is' delivery conditions and triggering refunds or loyalty point adjustments if items are substandard.
information_requirements.information_source: Digital signatures, photographic evidence, and sensor logs generated during the handover process.

information_requirements.information_requirement: Real-time payment authorization and settlement status
information_requirements.description: Immediate confirmation of fund availability, transaction success/failure status, and precise split of funds between customer, platform, and store partners.
information_requirements.business_purpose: To ensure financial integrity, prevent order fulfillment on unauthorized transactions, and guarantee timely settlement of commissions and payouts.
information_requirements.information_usage: Acts as the trigger for order completion and the basis for calculating and distributing revenue shares among stakeholders.
information_requirements.information_source: Secure communication channels with Payment Providers and internal ledger systems.

information_requirements.information_requirement: Regulatory compliance status and licensing validity
information_requirements.description: Current validity of operating licenses, food safety certifications for stores, and labor law compliance status for delivery agents in specific geographic zones.
information_requirements.business_purpose: To mitigate legal risk, ensure authorization to operate in specific markets, and maintain adherence to food safety and labor regulations.
information_requirements.information_usage: Used to dynamically restrict or enable service in specific zones and to audit partner capabilities before order allocation.
information_requirements.information_source: Government databases, third-party compliance verification services, and internal audit records.
